test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 60 men can complete a work in 40 days. They start work together but after every 10 day, 5 men leave the work. In how many days will the work be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

Number of days taken by 60 men to complete the work = 40

Number of men leave the work after every 10 day = 5

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total workload = 60 × 40 = 2400 units

⇒ 60 men did the work in 10 days = 600 units

⇒ 55 men did the work in 10 days = 55
